brief: Apply a matching-window key-release message and optional scan remapping.
decl: std::uint32_t input_key_release(std::span<std::byte> keys, std::span<const std::byte, 128> remap, std::uint32_t remap_present, std::uint32_t enabled, std::uint32_t message_window, std::uint32_t target_window, std::uint32_t message_bits);

bookkeeping.scope: Complete original release-message producer, no substituted dependencies or host APIs.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Caller-owned key image covering the selected mapped byte; disjoint 128-byte optional remap. Nonzero enabled and matching opaque window identities gate mutation. Original third, fourth and sixth arguments are unused; original pointer faults are outside the span contract.
bookkeeping.acceptance: Met: 688 complete original-body cases exact on MSVC and Zig/Clang, with no input substitutions. Six connected query/release traces also match. See docs/recovery/input-key-state.md.
unresolved: Key-down queue/translation, window dispatch and live hardware integration.
